name: klicktipp
description: KlickTipp toolkit: write, review and prepare KlickTipp email newsletters — drafts, drag-and-drop content, audience, sender, test sends and the dispatch confirmation — and read the opt-in processes of the account, over the KlickTipp MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Write and prepare KlickTipp email newsletters, and read the account's opt-in processes. The actual dispatch is always confirmed by a person in KlickTipp.
interface.longDescription: Connects to the KlickTipp MCP server (https://mcp.klicktipp.com/mcp, OAuth) and exposes two parts of the KlickTipp product API as tools. Newsletters: search them, read one through projections for metadata, audience, drag-and-drop content, delivery configuration and dispatch state, create and update a draft, replace and publish its content, configure sender and reply address, send a test to a verified address, and prepare the real dispatch. Preparing the dispatch sends nothing: it validates everything, states who would receive the newsletter, and returns a short-lived single-use confirmation URL that only the logged-in person can open and confirm in KlickTipp. Opt-in: read the account's opt-in processes and their configuration, and resolve the pending or thank-you URL a subscriber is redirected to.
defaultPrompt: Show me my opt-in processes and which of them use double opt-in.
Create a newsletter draft for my webinar list and send a test to my own address.
Where does my last newsletter stand — was it sent, and to how many people?
